LOKNI – healthy alternative to the bottled water 
LOKNI is an ESG project which protects the environment and the health of people. It is an ecological alternative to bottled water, which decreases the amount of plastic. It is a simple idea. Provided that somebody has got a reliable and trustworthy resource of excellent water at hand, they draw this water into their own bottle and do not buy a PET bottle.

Free thanks to the partners of the project 
LOKNI is a network of smart filtration water dispensers at more than 50 faculties of Czech universities. It is the partners of the project who most often contribute to the price of the water for students. They are doing good and in return for that they get their space on the LCD of the LOKNI devices and in the banners of the application. 

At the moment LOKNI is within the reach of about 135 thousand students and the total of the savings of the PET bottles (0.5 l) is about 300,000 bottles per month.

Healthy water for anybody
LOKNI treats the tap water at the moment when you draw it into your own bottle. It rids the water of undesirable tastes, smells, chlorine and micro-impurities of the size of 0.2 micron. It also removes most of the pesticides and remains of medicaments. Furthermore, the UV light eliminates the bacteria. Users can draw sparkling or still water and all the water is cooled. They draw the water using the LOKNI mobile application. 

SDGs Awards
